read_secret: read a secret from the secret manager by name using async or sync read methods
write_secret: write a secret value to the secret manager with an optional description and tags
delete_secret: delete a secret from the secret manager with an optional recovery window
rotate_secret: rotate a secret by creating a new one with a new value and deleting the old one
implement_secret_manager: implement a concrete secret manager by extending BaseSecretManager with async and sync read/write/delete methods
